body:
INSTAGRAM
Use AI as a running coach without getting injured: give it your real week, ask for easy runs and rest.

Most free plans assume 6 runs a week and no bad days. Then you miss two sessions and quit.
Slide 1 is the prompt. Fill in your runs, your longest run, your goal and your weeks.
Slide 6 is the weekly check-in that keeps the plan honest.
AI plans, your body decides: pain that does not go away is a physio question, not a prompt.

Running anything soon? Tell me your goal and I'll ask AI for your first week.
Follow @manrajtalks for more AI for real life.

TIKTOK
Use AI as a running coach without getting injured. The prompt is on slide 1. Running anything soon? Tell me your goal in the comments.
